## Summary

What changes, and why? Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. Distinguish local tests from host or deployment verification; list anything not tested.

## Compatibility

Does this change a schema, API, scope, hook, adapter contract, or upgrade behavior? Include migration and rollback considerations when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and has relevant regression coverage or documentation checks.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior; shared README changes are reflected in both languages.
- [ ] I reviewed the diff for credentials, personal memory, real conversation content, and runtime artifacts.
- [ ] Publication checks pass for the worktree and staged changes.
- [ ] I have not claimed production readiness or host compatibility based only on a local test.
